suggestion.topic: Python AsyncIO vs Threading: When to Stop Blocking Your Loop
suggestion.rationale: Developers frequently misuse threading for I/O-bound tasks where asyncio shines, leading to severe GIL contention and unpredictable performance drop-offs. Addressing this confusion directly captures high-intent search traffic.
suggestion.hook_angle: Stop using Python threads for web scrapers. Here is why your multi-threaded app is actually running slower than single-threaded code.
